messages:
lisa_sales: Heads up — Acme SIG pack due EOD Fri (about 48h). I started a question-by-question sheet here: https://docs.internal.redwood/acme-sig (please don't share). Need evidence for Q3.2 (encryption at rest), Q5.1 (access control / RBAC), and Q9.4 (incident response). Who can own which items?

ajay_seceng: I can take Q3.2 and Q5.1. For encryption we'll reference KMS config, CMK rotation policy, and our disk encryption note. I'll upload artifacts to the secure bucket and paste paths here. @tom_se can you confirm the config snippet for Dedicated vs Hosted KMS?

tom_se: Yep — I'll add `redwood-kms-rotation.pdf` + the example conf for dedicated/private. Will also write a 2-line explanation about how keys are handled per deployment. Upload path I'll use: 
```
s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-21/
```

caroline_support: I'll own Q9.4 (IR). I have the latest incident playbook and the drill report from Feb. Where should I drop drafts for review?

lisa_sales: Drop everything in the s3 path Tom posted and put a short note in the sheet (Status: draft/review). I'll flag items as ready or needs-review so we can hand off to compliance if needed.

sig-bot: Reminder: SIG submission deadline in ~40 hours. Outstanding: Q3.2, Q5.1, Q9.4. Automated checklist: encryption, access controls, IR docs.

ajay_seceng: Uploaded initial artifacts to S3: 
```
- s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-21/redwood-kms-rotation.pdf  (KMS rotation policy)
- s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-21/kms-rotation-logs.csv  (rotation events last 12 months)
- s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-21/rbac-mapping.xlsx  (role->permission mapping)
```
Short note in sheet under Q3.2/Q5.1.

tom_se: Quick example we can paste into the SIG answer for Q3.2:
```json
{"encryption_at_rest": "AES-256 via disk-level LUKS, CMK managed in customer or Redwood KMS", "rotation_frequency": "90 days (policy + logs attached)"}
```
Use that as the summary and reference the PDFs/log exports.

caroline_support: Uploaded IR playbook and drill summary: 
- s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-21/ir-playbook.pdf
- s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-21/drill-report-feb2026.pdf
Added notes in the sheet under Q9.4 — paging timeline, escalation matrix, and post-mortem cadence. @ajay_seceng can you confirm the mean-time-to-detect number?

ajay_seceng: Checked the drill report. MTTD in drills ~14 mins, MTTR ~2.5 hours. I'll add a short footnote clarifying these are drill metrics and link to the live monitoring dashboards. Also customer asked for proof of quarterly key rotation — I've attached filtered logs (kms-rotation-logs.csv). Compliance might ask for a signed statement.

lisa_sales: I'll coordinate with compliance for a signoff if they need to stamp anything. One more quick sales question from Acme: for the SIG doc should we mark Dedicated deployment as "N/A" for certain AWS controls because it's customer-managed? Thoughts?

tom_se: For accuracy, call out both options: Hosted (Redwood-managed keys) and Dedicated/Private (customer-managed keys). Don't mark N/A — instead add a note that control ownership shifts to customer when they opt for customer-managed keys. That covers their question.

caroline_support: Also FYI they asked for a SOC2 scope doc — I can provide a 1-page summary and link to the SOC2 coverage we send to customers. I'll upload to the same folder.

lisa_sales: Perfect. Final push — please upload final artifacts and mark status in the sheet by 10:00 PT tomorrow so I can assemble the submission and send to Acme sec team. :thumbsup:

ajay_seceng: Will do.

tom_se: On it.

caroline_support: Done — I'll ping when SOC2 summary is in.

lisa_sales: Thanks everyone — will consolidate and post the compiled zip to the same S3 path when complete.
